about_the_game:
Step into a world of fashion and adventure and give your hamsters a style overhaul worthy of legends with the Tales & Tails Skin Bundle, five iconic skin packs spanning eras, intrigue and illusion:

  • Ancient Skin Pack: Egyptian pharaoh headdresses, Greek togas and golden laurel wreaths

  • Conquerors Skin Pack: rugged Viking tunics, horned helmets, pirate coats and tricorn hats

  • Detectives Skin Pack: trench coats and classic detective caps

  • Magicians Skin Pack: flowing capes, top hats and mysterious emblems

  • Time Travellers Skin Pack: sleek futuristic suits and high-tech accessories

Mix and match these five packs for endless hamster style combinations!
